Chronic foot pain that keeps coming back? 👀⚠️ The problem might not just be plantar fasciitis or tight muscles. What if the real issue is tibial nerve entrapment at the tarsal tunnel? The tibial nerve travels behind the inside of the ankle through the tarsal tunnel before branching into nerves that supply the foot. When the nerve and surrounding tissues become restricted, it can contribute to: 🔥 burning or aching foot pain 🔥 tingling or numbness into the foot 🔥 heel or arch pain 🔥 pain that worsens with standing or walking 🔥 symptoms that can mimic plantar fasciitis So even if you keep stretching your foot, rolling it out, or treating the plantar fascia… you may be missing an underlying nerve restriction ❌ By identifying and removing adhesion around the tibial nerve at the tarsal tunnel, we help restore normal nerve and tissue mobility instead of only chasing where the foot hurts. ✅💥 📍 Wildcard Spine & Sport — Manhattan, New York City 💬 Comment “PAIN” if you’re tired of suffering and want real answers. #footpaintreatment #footpainrelief #footpain #PlantarFasciitis #PlantarFasciitisRelief
